title: CDCAD resolved recipe v1 (expressions are resolved before validation)

units.description: mm (default), cm, m or in: the unit of every length in the recipe; exports are always mm

params.description: Named numbers or =expressions; any string value starting with = elsewhere is arithmetic on them

density.description: Material density in g/cm^3 (PLA 1.24, PETG 1.27, ABS 1.04, aluminium 2.70); reports add mass_g

oneOf.description: Axis-aligned rectangle centred on `center`, optionally with rounded corners.

radius.description: Corner radius; at most half the shorter side

oneOf.description: Circle as a regular polygon with `segments` sides.
Ellipse with radii [rx, ry].
Regular polygon such as a hexagon. Give either `radius` (centre to corner) or `across_flats` (distance between opposite flat sides, as for nuts and hex keys).

across_flats.description: Width across flats; the alternative to radius

oneOf.description: Polygon from points, optionally with holes (each hole is a point ring).

holes.description: Rings inside the boundary that are cut out

oneOf.description: A polyline thickened to `width`, like a pen line.

closed.description: Join the last point back to the first

oneOf.description: Smooth curve through points (a cubic spline). Closed, it is a smooth outline that joins itself without a kink; with `width` it is drawn as a line of that width instead, open unless `closed`.

points.description: Points the curve passes through, in order

closed.description: Join the end back to the start (default: true without width, false with width)

width.description: Draw the curve as a line of this width instead of filling it

cap.description: End cap style for an open line

oneOf.description: Rounded slot (stadium) of overall size [width, height].

Region between the graph of a function and a base line: with var x it is the area between y = f(x) and y = base for x in range; with var y it is between x = f(y) and x = base, which is the shape `revolve` turns into a vase or knob.

f.description: The function, of x or y according to var, e.g. 18 + 6*sin(y/12)

base.description: The other boundary: a number or a function of the same variable

oneOf.description: Closed parametric curve (x(t), y(t)) for t in [start, end]; the end joins the start. Self-intersecting curves are filled even-odd.

x.description: x as a function of t

y.description: y as a function of t

oneOf.description: Text outline from a TrueType/OpenType font; bundled DejaVu Sans by default (Latin, Greek and math symbols). `size` is the height of capital letters. Use \n for new lines.

path.description: A .ttf/.otf font file instead of the bundled one

line_spacing.description: Line height as a multiple of the font size

segments.description: Line segments per curved glyph edge

oneOf.description: Region from SVG path data. Closed subpaths are filled; give `width` to stroke instead.

d.description: SVG path data, e.g. M0 0 H40 V25 H0 Z

width.description: Stroke the path with this width instead of filling it

step.description: Maximum spacing of samples on curves

oneOf.description: Filled shapes from an SVG file, in true size (96 px per inch). Y is flipped so the drawing reads the right way up. Open filled paths are closed, as SVG viewers do; strokes and text are not imported.

path.description: SVG file, relative to the recipe

step.description: Curve sample spacing in SVG px

flip_y.description: Flip Y for right-handed CAD coordinates

oneOf.description: Closed contours from a DXF file (lines, arcs, circles, ellipses, splines, polylines at Z=0). Nested contours become holes. Layer names match regardless of case.

path.description: DXF file, relative to the recipe

oneOf.description: Merge profiles.
Subtract every later profile from the first.
Keep the area common to all profiles.
Grow (positive) or shrink (negative) a profile by a distance; rounds or mitres corners.
Round the corners of a profile with an exact radius: outside (convex) corners, inside (concave) corners or both. Parts narrower than twice the radius are removed.
Bevel the corners of a profile; at a right-angled corner each leg of the bevel is `distance`.
Scale, then rotate (degrees), then translate a profile about the origin.
Convex hull of one or more profiles.
Copies of a profile: copy i is rotated by i*rotate degrees about `center`, then moved by i*step. With step [0, 0] and rotate 360/count this is a polar (circular) pattern.
Rectangular grid of copies: counts [nx, ny] spaced by step [dx, dy].
Opening of an arch: straight legs of height `leg` under a semi-ellipse of `rise`.
Arch band of `thickness` around an arch opening.
Rectangular frame: outer size minus an inset of `border`.
Box centred on the origin.
Cylinder along Z, centred on the origin.
Cone or frustum along Z, centred on the origin: `radius` at the bottom, `radius_top` at the top.
Sphere centred on the origin (an icosphere).
Torus around the Z axis, centred on the origin.

major.description: Distance from the axis to the tube centre

oneOf.description: Solid from vertices and faces (each face lists vertex indices, any winding; polygons are split into triangles). Without faces it is the convex hull of the points.
Extrude a profile up from `z`. `twist` turns the top (degrees) and `scale` resizes it, which makes twisted columns and tapers.

twist.description: Rotation of the top in degrees, counter-clockwise

scale.description: Top size relative to the bottom: a number or [sx, sy]

top.description: Round or bevel the top edges: {fillet: r} or {chamfer: d}, optionally segments

bottom.description: Round or bevel the bottom edges, like top

oneOf.description: Turn a profile around the Z axis. Profile X is the radius (X >= 0), profile Y becomes Z.

profile.description: Profile name: one polygon without holes, X >= 0

angle.description: Sweep angle in degrees; less than 360 leaves flat ends

oneOf.description: Skin a solid through profiles at increasing Z heights (one hole-free outline each).

smooth.description: Curve the sides through the sections with a spline instead of straight lines (3+ sections)

steps.description: Layers between two sections when smooth

oneOf.description: Sweep a profile along a 3D path: a list of `points` or a parametric `curve`. The profile's X and Y axes follow the path with rotation-minimising frames, or with `frame` up, keep Y towards the `up` vector (best for helices: threads, springs). `closed` joins the ends into a ring.

curve.description: {x, y, z: functions of t, t: [a, b], samples}

twist.description: Extra roll along the path in degrees

scale.description: Profile scale at the end (linear along the path)

smooth.description: Run the path along a smooth cubic spline through `points` instead of straight segments

samples.description: Path points for a smooth path

oneOf.description: Solid where f(x, y, z) < 0, meshed inside `bounds`: spheres, gyroids, blobs. The region is clipped (and closed) by the bounds box.

f.description: Field; negative inside, e.g. x**2 + y**2 + z**2 - 10**2

resolution.description: Grid spacing; smaller is finer and slower

level.description: Surface where f equals this value

oneOf.description: Solid under a surface z = f(x, y) over a rectangle, down to a flat bottom at `base`.

f.description: Height as a function of x and y

base.description: Z of the flat bottom; f must stay above it

oneOf.description: Relief from a grayscale picture or a 2D .npy array of values in [0, 1]: black is `base`, white is base + height. Pictures keep their on-screen orientation (top row at high Y); arrays put row 0 at Y = 0. 16-bit PNGs keep their precision.

max_samples.description: Resample the longer side to at most this

flip_y.description: Flip rows (default: true for pictures, false for arrays)

oneOf.description: Mesh file (STL, 3MF, OBJ, PLY, OFF, GLB). 3MF files carry their unit; for others give `units`.

repair.description: Merge vertices, drop degenerate faces, fill simple holes

oneOf.description: Fuse solids into one (mesh boolean).
Subtract every later solid from the first (mesh boolean).
Keep the volume common to all solids (mesh boolean).
Put solids in one mesh without fusing them (fast; overlaps remain overlaps).
Scale, then rotate (XYZ Euler degrees), then translate about the origin; or one 4x4 matrix.

matrix.description: Affine 4x4 for column vectors, instead of the others

oneOf.description: Reflect a solid in the plane through `origin` with `normal`; `keep` also keeps the original (fused).

keep.description: Union the mirror image with the original

oneOf.description: Copies of a solid: copy i is rotated by i*rotate (XYZ degrees about the origin), then moved by i*step. Rotate [0, 0, 360/count] makes a polar pattern.

fuse.description: Union the copies (false just collects them)

oneOf.description: 3D grid of copies: counts [nx, ny, nz] spaced by step.
Convex hull of one or more solids.
Round the edges of any solid with a ball of `radius`: convex edges lose material, concave edges (where two parts meet) gain a smooth fillet, which blends a union into one organic piece.
Bevel the edges of any solid. Edges parallel to an axis get a 45-degree bevel whose legs are `distance`; other edges get a bevel of similar size.
Turn a faceted solid into a smooth, organic one by subdividing it onto a curved surface. Edges whose faces meet at more than `sharp_angle` stay creased; `smoothness` rounds those too.

sharp_angle.description: Edges sharper than this (degrees) stay sharp

smoothness.description: Rounding of the sharp edges, 0 (crisp) to 1 (all smooth)

refine.description: Split every edge into this many pieces

edge_length.description: Refine to about this edge length instead of refine

oneOf.description: Slice with a plane and keep the side the normal points to; `cap` closes the cut face.

cap.description: Close the cut (needs a solid input)

oneOf.description: Merge vertices, drop degenerate and duplicate faces, fix normals, fill simple holes.
Reduce the triangle count to about `faces` (quadric decimation; approximate).
Move a solid so one of its bounding-box anchors meets an anchor of a target solid.
Drill cylindrical holes into a solid at `positions` (hole centres) along an axis.
Flat panel with optional cutouts in the XY, XZ or YZ plane, centred on `center`.

cutouts.description: Holes: rectangle, circle, slot or arch shapes

oneOf.description: Wall along X from Z = 0, thickness centred on Y = 0, with optional cutouts in local X/Z.
Rectangular frame solid; plane XZ by default.
Arch solid of `depth` (along Y) standing on Z = 0.
Rectangular beam from `start` to `end`; `roll` turns its cross-section.

exports.description: [{solid, path, allow_open?}] files to write; .stl, .3mf, .step (or .stp; planar faces), .obj, .ply, .off or .glb

checks.description: [{solid, volume|area|mass|components|size_x|size_y|size_z: {min, max} or {approx, rel|abs}, is_volume, fits: [x, y, z]}] assertions; a failing check stops the build before anything is written
